candidates.reason: Unit tests for scrapy.utils.misc.build_from_crawler(), the helper this change generalizes; asserts the from_crawler()-preferring, __init__()-falling-back contract used by every converted call site.
Crawler._apply_settings() builds LOG_FORMATTER and the extension manager via direct from_crawler() calls today; crawler-level component retrieval tests cover the same managers.
LOG_FORMATTER is loaded in scrapy/crawler.py and instantiated with lf_cls.from_crawler(self); these tests cover LogFormatter construction and custom subclasses configured through LOG_FORMATTER.
MiddlewareManager.from_crawler() builds every middleware entry with build_from_crawler(); the manager itself is one of the internal construction paths that direct from_crawler() callers delegate to.

ScrapyDownloader.__init__ constructs DownloaderMiddlewareManager.from_crawler(crawler); this suite covers downloader construction and the from_crawler/init alternatives for downloader-side components.

Scraper.__init__ builds SpiderMiddlewareManager via from_crawler() and the ITEM_PROCESSOR class directly with itemproc_cls.from_crawler(crawler), both of which this change converts to build_from_crawler().
StatsMailer.from_crawler() calls MailSender.from_crawler(crawler), and these tests monkeypatch MailSender.from_crawler to observe that construction.
MemoryUsage (scrapy/extensions/memusage.py) builds MailSender.from_crawler(crawler) when MEMUSAGE_NOTIFY_MAIL is set, the second MailSender call site in this change.
MailSender is the class whose from_crawler() usage is generalized in the memusage and statsmailer extensions; MailSender.from_crawler() itself is defined in scrapy/mail.py.
RobotsTxtMiddleware calls self._parserimpl.from_crawler(self.crawler, ...) twice (dependency check and parsing), which this change replaces with build_from_crawler().
Defines the RobotParser.from_crawler(crawler, robotstxt_body) contract that ROBOTSTXT_PARSER backends must satisfy after the construction path is generalized.
STATS_CLASS is instantiated directly as load_object(...)(self) in Crawler._apply_settings(); custom STATS_CLASS tests exercise that construction path, which becomes build_from_crawler().

ExecutionEngine.__init__ instantiates the DOWNLOADER setting class directly as downloader_cls(crawler) and builds the scheduler/scraper, so engine-level tests cover the construction paths being generalized.
